protectedCi.finding: GitHub job conclusion was success, but gh run logs show windows_contract_audit.py raised FileNotFoundError for untracked windows/bin/zapret/strong-override-hosts.txt. Subsequent commands returned zero, masking the failure.

xhamsterStability.detail: In four restart cycles DNS listed 104.16.3.81 first; normal curl/libcurl operation still completed on 104.16.4.81 with HTTP 200, demonstrating client failover. No brittle shared-CDN IP pinning or global aggressive profile was promoted.

boundaries.gemini: FAIL_HTTP_403 on current public egress in curl and real Chrome; not counted as PASS. Requires separate egress-changing architecture if authorized.
boundaries.universalAdultGuarantee: UNPROVABLE for every remote domain/CDN edge; representative normal-client acceptance and maintained catalog are the supported evidence level.

decision.claim: Promote v1.5.1 as final for the validated direct-only architecture; do not add brittle IP pinning or global stronger DPI strategy solely to make one forced CDN edge pass.
decision.rationale: Normal-client Linux behavior remained usable across repeated restarts through healthy-edge failover; global Strong had documented regressions on other sites, and static shared-CDN pinning would add systemic risk without improving validated user outcome.

exactNextAction: Run full tracked source audit, commit/push the source reproducibility repair, require fresh-checkout protected CI to genuinely pass Windows+Linux, merge to main, then verify v1.5.1 tag/assets remain unchanged.

rootCause: windows/bin/zapret/strong-override-hosts.txt was ignored and not tracked although the installer/manifest/Start-Direct contract depended on it.
Hash-pinned Windows text payloads had no explicit EOL attributes; core.autocrlf=true produced checkout-dependent raw SHA-256 bytes.
Windows GitHub Actions multi-command audit step did not exit after a failed external python command, allowing a later passing command to make the step green.
prevention: Force-track the exact Windows strong-override source payload.
Pin published byte conventions in .gitattributes: hosts.txt=CRLF, adult-fallback-hosts.txt=LF, strong-override-hosts.txt=CRLF.
Require source contract checks for tracked override, EOL policy and CI fail-fast.
Add explicit LASTEXITCODE exits after every Windows external audit command.
sourceReproducibilityRepair.releaseImpact: NO_RUNTIME_ASSET_CHANGE. Published v1.5.1 artifacts remain exact-installed and post-publish verified; repair makes future clean-source builds/audits reproducible.
